settings.heading: Safety
settings.text: Hypergogo Cruiser 12 is designed with safety as the top priority. It features a rear hub brake system that ensures reliable and efficient braking performance. The moderate top speed of 16 km/h also ensures the safety of children during operation.

settings.heading: Rear disc brake
settings.text: Equipped with a rear disc brake, ensuring reliable braking performance for added safety.

settings.heading: Pneumatic tires
settings.text: The 12 x 2.5-inch tires provide excellent grip and stability on any terrain, ensuring a smooth and safe ride.

settings.heading: Speed
settings.text: Three-speed modes available, with a top speed of 16 km/h, ensuring a safe and enjoyable ride for children.

settings.heading: Performance and Functionality
settings.text: The Cruiser 12 is equipped with a 24V 150W motor that provides a thrilling and exciting driving experience for children. With a lead-acid battery capacity of 24V 5A, it provides a stable and consistent power supply. The three-speed gear system allows for different driving needs, and the maximum load of 65 kg makes it suitable for children of different sizes. With a cruising range of up to 20 km, children can enjoy hours of fun without interruption.

settings.heading: Motor
settings.text: Powered by a 24V 150W motor, giving children an exciting and enjoyable driving experience.

settings.heading: Battery
settings.text: The 24V 5A lead-acid battery provides stable power support for longer driving distance.

settings.heading: HYPER GOGO App
settings.text: The app allows riders to change the light modes and working modes of the ATV, as well as set the initial speed for different modes.

settings.heading: Weight capacity
settings.text: The maximum weight capacity of 65 kg allows for children of different sizes to ride comfortably.

settings.heading: Colorful power button
settings.text: Our ATV also features a colorful power button that adds a fun touch to the design and makes it easy for kids to turn it on and off.

settings.heading: Design and Appearance
settings.text: With its sleek and stylish Harley-inspired design, the Cruiser 12 is sure to turn heads. It has a compact size of 45 x 21 x 29 inches, making it ideal for children aged 3 to 8 years old. The 12 x 2.5-inch tires provide excellent grip and stability on any terrain, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride.

settings.heading: Fuel Tank Bag
settings.text: The Cruiser 12 is not only stylish but also functional. It features a fuel tank bag that adds an extra touch of coolness to the Harley-inspired design. The bag is perfect for carrying small items like snacks, toys, or a water bottle.

settings.heading: Front Headlight
settings.text: In addition to the fuel tank bag, the Cruiser 12 also has a front headlight that adds to its realistic motorcycle look. The headlight not only enhances the appearance but also provides illumination for better visibility during low-light conditions.

settings.heading: Fenders
settings.text: The Cruiser 12 is designed with both style and practicality in mind. It features front and rear fenders that not only enhance its sleek and sporty appearance, but also provide protection against mud and dirt, ensuring a clean and comfortable ride for your child. The fenders are made with durable materials, ensuring long-lasting performance and minimal maintenance. With the Cruiser 12, you can have peace of mind knowing that your child is not only riding in style, but also staying clean and safe.
